paper_title: RedWhale An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining
caption: : Model complexity analysis.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between two variables, referred to as "Input Complexity" and "Embedding Complexity," against a shared variable named "Vocab Size". The x-axis is labeled "Vocab Size", with a linear scale type, ranging from 10,000 to 40,000 with tick intervals of 5,000. The y-axis on the left and right is labeled "Scaled Ratio" and displays a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, also with intervals of 0.2. The plot contains two lines: the first line, representing "Input Complexity", is blue with a solid line style and circular markers. This line starts at a y-value of 1.0 when "Vocab Size" less than 10,000 and decreases consistently to a y-value of approximately 0.0 when "Vocab Size" reaches 40,000. The second line, representing "Embedding Complexity", is cyan with a solid line style and circular markers. This line begins at a y-value of approximately 0.0 at a "Vocab Size" less than 10,000 and increases steadily to a y-value of 1.0 when "Vocab Size" reaches 40,000. A legend is given top right.
